Lets talk about monster builds! favorite monsters! Rune power ups and the like.

I can start with some basics about runes.
Runes can be found as 1* up to 6* just like monsters, but the number of stars cannot be upgraded. Powering up runes will upgrade your main stats, and can add or upgrade sub-stats as well. Sub-stats will either power up or add a new stat at power up 3, 6, 9, 12
power up 0= normal (white), 3=Magic (green), 6= Rare (blue), 9 Hero (purple), 12 legend (orange) Any runes you have that are 3* and below: do not power up past +3, it's just a waste. use them to get better runes and power those up.

There are 6 slots to engrave runes on your monsters.

- slots 1, 3, and 5 will always have a flat (no%) main stat that is predetermined depending on the slot. 1 = attack, 3 = defense, 5 = HP.
- For slots 2, 4, and 6 you are able to get % as well as flat rate stats. You should sell flat rate runes and keep percentage in these slots. The exception is SPD will always be a flat main stat. Slots 2,4,6 have many more possibilities. 2= SPD, HP, ATK, or DEF; 4= ATK, DEF, HP, Crit Rate, or Crit Damage 6= HP, ATK, DEF, ACC(uracy), RES(istance)

Sub-stats are also VERY important.
As you power up your runes your main stats and sub-stats will improve.
Sub-stats are located underneath the rune picture on the left hand side.
If you get a rune with a sub-stat that is directly below the main stat, that rune will also have a slightly different title. Something like Durable, Strong, Ferocious, Quick, Resistant, Tenacious etc., will be added in front of the rune type. If you get one of these runes where an extra sub-stat is included directly under the main stat, then this sub-stat will NOT improve along with the rest! It also means that you will not get another sub-stat of the same kind below it. So if you are trying to improve your crit rate with sub-stats do not use a Mortal Fatal rune because the crit rate % will not improve with power-ups.

So say I have white 5* Mortal Fatal rune in slot one ready for its first power up. Lets also say this rune has a starting main stat of ATK +15 and a Crit Rate substat of 6% directly under it. Now if i power this rune up to +15 the ATK stat would now be +160 and the substat will stay 6%.

There is a lot more to add to this but I just wanted to touch on the basics and let this expand from there.
